messages:
joel: Starting a fresh thread for the Dedicated listing quickstart + licensing notes. Goal: tiny terraform + helm example in the listing, clear trial activation flow, and licensing text for GOV/enterprise customers.

priya: Love it. For SKUs let's avoid long product codes in user-facing places. Internally we can have RDW-D-STD / RDW-D-PRO / RDW-D-ENT and expose friendly names: 'Dedicated Standard', 'Dedicated Pro', 'Dedicated Enterprise'.

tasha: Trial concerns: on marketplace trials we must surface that trial does not include SLA or reserved capacity. Also needs explicit opt-in to convert to paid at end. Legal wants an email or checkbox for conversion.

joel: Noted. Ops: do we have a safe default that disables autoscale on trial instances? We should also avoid KMS by default for trial.

ops: yes, trial terraform will set autoscale_enabled = false and kms_key = null. We'll add a comment in the quickstart. Example snippet we'll include in the listing: ```hcl
module "redwood_dedicated" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/terraform/dedicated-module"
  capacity_tier = "standard"
  enable_autoscale = false # trial default
  kms_key = null
}
```

evan: For the quickstart asset, prefer embedding a 6-line example + link to full repo. Marketplace assets have size limits; keep it under 200KB.

priya: Licensing text draft idea: 'Redwood Dedicated Trial provides a 30-day evaluation of features. Trials do not include SLA or guaranteed capacity. Conversion requires affirmative consent to subscribe; billing will start only after consent is given.' I'll put a plain-text and a short legal paragraph.

legal-bot: Reminder: Publisher listing must include Authorized Representative contact and Tax ID in the manifest. Also include the export classification language for cryptography (EAR).

joel: Thanks. Priya can you add the conversion checkbox wording and a short audit trail requirement for recorded consent? We want to avoid disputes.

priya: Will do. Suggest: a one-click 'Start subscription' on our hosted flow with emailed invoice + confirmation. That will satisfy explicit consent and provide an audit log.

ops: Regarding billing metrics: marketplace supports 'usage units' (we'll meter tokens) and 'capacity_hours' for reserved capacity. We'll publish both dimensions and a fallback price for unmetered cases. Proposed manifest fields: 
```json
{"sku":"RDW-DEMO-TRIAL-30","dimensions":["tokens","capacity_hours"],"billing_notes":"tokens metered for inference; capacity_hours for reserved pools"}
```

evan: Also include a "trial_caps" object in the quickstart text: max_tokens_per_minute, max_concurrent_requests. Keeps trial predictable.

joel: Who's owning branding assets? Tasha please coordinate with marketing for 3 screenshots: console, quickstart diagram, architecture. We need PNGs and alt text.

tasha: On it. Will ask creative for square logo + 3 screenshots. ETA Wed.

legal-bot: For Azure Gov / GovCloud: include a region_restrictions tag and a data_residency_policy paragraph. Some customers will need region-limited SKUs.

priya: We'll add region_restrictions: ["us-gov-west", "us-gov-east"] to enterprise SKU only. Trial will be global except govcloud.

ops: One more ops note: marketplace quickstart should include a minimal runbook item for on-call handoff when a customer subscribes. We'll link to internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-dedicated-onboard

joel: Summary action items: 1) Priya to produce trial conversion copy + legal paragraph and consent flow spec (due Tue). 2) Ops to produce minimal terraform example + trial caps and push to shared drive (due Fri). 3) Tasha to pull marketing screenshots and logo (due Wed). 4) Evan to verify manifest size and add manifest example to tracker (due Thu).

priya: I'll ping finance for Tax ID and authorized rep contact and post here when I have them.

ops: Pushed initial quickstart to drive: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/quickstarts/dedicated-quickstart-v1.md (please review).

joel: Great. Let's reconvene Fri 9am for a final pre-submit check. Short call only.

evan: 9am works.

tasha: Added a quick checklist item in the tracker for image alt text and accessibility checks.

legal-bot: Submission checklist: contact_info=missing, tax_id=pending, quickstart=present, branding=pending, region_restrictions=partial.

joel: Thanks all. Drop updates here and I'll mark progress in the onboarding tracker.
